description: This file defines interfaces related to serialization type conversion, filtering by type name, and type allowance in the Orleans.Serialization namespace.

classes.name: ITypeConverter
classes.description: Interface for converting between Type objects and their string representations.

classes.name: ITypeNameFilter
classes.description: Interface for determining whether a type name is allowed for loading or serialization.

classes.name: ITypeFilter
classes.description: Interface for determining whether a Type object is allowed for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format a Type as a string.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a Type.

methods.name: IsTypeNameAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a type name is allowed for loading or serialization.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a Type is allowed for serialization or deserialization.
